The '''''Firewing''''' was an unmarked [[Starship/Legends|starship]] originally owned by a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] and some of his [[Human/Legends|human]] co-pilots. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Hunter (individual)|Scree]] killed them aboard a neutral [[Space station/Legends|space station]] above [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], taking ''Firewing'' to sneak aboard the [[Founder (Valor-class)|''Founder'']], the personal flagship of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Number One With a Bullet|Corellia Orbital Station}}</ref>
